tools.name: search_verified_places
tools.description: Find places and stations by name, kind, category, area, nearness or opening time. Answers only from data-standard v1 records; null values are reported as not_known. It does not return train times: for a station's exits or its last trains, call get_station_exit with the station name.

tools.name: find_active_popups
tools.description: Pop-ups running on a day. Returns an empty list with reason_code no_v1_records until the city publishes pop-up records in data-standard v1.

tools.name: get_station_exit
tools.description: The station record, its exits, its last-train times by line and direction (weekday, Saturday and Sunday; Seoul and Busan publish them; other cities answer last_trains as not_published), and (with "to") the walk from the station to a destination record. tools.name: plan_local_route
tools.description: Can these stops fit in this time, in this order? Judges each stop with its posted hours on the date. The tool does not guess how long a visit takes: visit_min is required.
